API for creating, managing, and executing data processing workflows within the Xceptor platform. Enables programmatic orchestration of automated data processing pipelines including event-driven triggers, business rules execution, step configuration, and workflow run monitoring. Workflows define multi-step processing sequences for enrichment, validation, reconciliation, and exception handling of financial data.
